CSIRO Mouse Surveillance

Winter-2022 Seasonal Summary

Published

April 24, 2026

Overview

This report summarizes house mouse monitoring activities conducted during the Winter-2022 season across Australian grain-growing regions. Mouse abundance was assessed using three complementary survey methods: live-trapping at benchmark sites, and rapid assessments using chew cards and active burrow counts.

Live-trap Surveys: A total of 3,543 trap nights (1 trap night = 1 trap set for 1 night) were conducted across 12 benchmark sites in 5 regions spanning 3 states (survey period: June 2022 to September 2022). These surveys captured 222 individual house mice, allowing abundance estimates at these monitoring locations.

Rapid Assessment Surveys: Rapid assessments were conducted across 12 regions using two methods. Chew card surveys deployed 1,306 cards across 91 sites, with 13.2% showing evidence of mouse activity (172 cards chewed). Active burrow surveys searched 524 transects across 95 sites (survey period: June 2022 to August 2022), detecting active burrows in 4.2% of transects (total: 28 active burrows).
